title: better-bing-image-downloader manifest record
description: One line of a manifest.jsonl file written by Downloader.search(manifest=True) (v3.5.0+). This schema describes a full record written with the default field set (DEFAULT_MANIFEST_FIELDS; 10 fields in v3.5.0-v3.8.x, 11 fields from v3.9.0 with the addition of 'caption'). When a custom manifest_fields list is configured, each record is a projection of this schema containing only the requested fields.

index.description: 1-based per-search counter. Counts every record (ok, error, or skipped); strictly increasing within one search.

status.description: 'ok' = image saved; 'error' = download/validation failed; 'skipped' = filtered out (e.g. below min_dimension, v3.6.0+).

file.description: Saved file path relative to the working directory (e.g. 'dataset/cats/Image_1.jpg'). Null when nothing was saved (error/skipped records).

md5.description: MD5 hex digest of the saved file. Null when nothing was saved.

error.description: Exception class name on failure or skip (e.g. 'NetworkError', 'BelowMinDimension'). Null on success.

query.description: The search query that produced this record.

source_page.description: URL of the search-result page the image link was found on.

caption.description: Caption/title text supplied by the search backend (Bing 't' field, DuckDuckGo 'title' field). Null when the engine did not provide one. Added in v3.9.0.
